# Replace first occurrence on line 1
sed -i '1s/old_string/new_string/' filename.py

# Replace all occurrences in lines 1-10
sed -i '1,10s/old_string/new_string/g' filename.py
```

Use find on apps for ops/radar related files.
Look at the ops CSS for shell and radar feed layout rules.
Line 2 of ops.css makes .ops-app (the shell) a row. Inspect the top of the file and find the radar feed rules/usages.

function.arguments: {"command": "cd /work/apps/canvas/src/ops && sed -n '1,12p' ops.css; grep -rniE 'radar|feed' ops.css | head -30; grep -rnE 'className=\"[^\"]*(feed|radar)' . | head"}
function.name: bash

messages.content: Find the radar feed CSS and the markup of the feed, plus how .ops-app children are laid out.

function.arguments: {"command": "cd /work/apps/canvas/src && grep -rnE 'radar-feed|radar-.*feed|feed' --include=*.css . | head -30; grep -rnE 'radar-feed|className=\"[^\"]*feed' --include=*.tsx . | head -10; grep -n 'ops-app' ops/OpsApp.tsx | head"}
